description.subtitle: Water thermal bottle Runbott of Atlético de Madrid 600 ml - red
description.intro: The 600 ml Atlético Runbott thermomer from Madrid offers unique strength and design. Its double wall insulation keeps your drinks warm while wearing the shield and the name "ATLETI".
key_benefits: Athletic identity: official shield and name "ATLETI" laser engraving.
Keeps the temperature: double walled air insulation for hot or cold drinks.
Authentic taste: ceramic coating that preserves the original taste of each drink.
Estabilidad extra: base de goma antideslizante.
Durability and hygiene: stainless steel resistant to corrosion and bacteria.
Uso sostenible: 100% reutilizable y respetuoso con el medio ambiente.

Conserva la temperatura: aislamiento de aire con doble pared para bebidas frías o calientes.
Sabor auténtico: recubrimiento cerámico que preserva el gusto original de cada bebida.
Estabilidad extra: base de goma antideslizante.
